problems: The blind guess ('human figure with arms outstretched') does not match The Bridled Kite. The drawing reads as a kite or sail with a pennant, ribbons and tassels, not a person.

The sail has no real area. Apex (77257), right shoulder (77070) and left corner (77622) form a narrow spine, so the kite shape is not legible.
The tail stacks both tassels (77660, 77516) almost on the body's vertical axis, so they read as a stick descending from the sail rather than two tassels at the foot of a tail.
Labels collide: 'bend in the right-hand streamer' overlaps 'far tip of the right-hand streamer', and the 'left tassel' and 'right tassel' labels overlap each other and the figure.

Key stars are on roughly the right parts (pennant tip 76276 at top right, left ribbon 80179/80883 at left, streamer 75761/74975 at right, tassels at bottom), and the figure is upright with the sail at the top and tail below, so the orientation is correct.

Keep the pennant 76276 rising from the apex as a single clean line. Draw the left ribbon as a curve from 77622 through 80179 to 80883, and the right streamer from the tail through 75761 out to 74975. Separate the two tassels 77660 and 77516 horizontally at the foot of the tail so they do not stack on the spine. Build an independent silhouette outline with its own fill or offset rather than tracing the gold lines. Move the labels for 75761/74975 and for the two tassels so they do not overlap.
